name: Tyne Tunnels toll
law: Tyne and Wear Act 1976 s. 13 and the River Tyne (Tunnels) Order 2005: the River Tyne (Tunnels) (Revision of Tolls) Order 2023 (S.I. 2023/413), in force from 2023-05-01: class 3 (vehicles other than motorcycles and those up to 3.5 t) per passage either way; with `etc` the permit holder's price after discount.

sources.title: S.I. 2023/413, the River Tyne (Tunnels) Revision of Toll Order 2023

tolled_roads: The Tyne Tunnels (A19, Jarrow-Howdon), free-flow, either way.
